findings.highlight: This marks the second time I've betrayed Illya.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤはこれで二度裏切られた
findings.governingReading: The first betrayal belongs to Kiritsugu, the second to Shirou's repetition of that choice; イリヤは is the victim subject.
findings.explanation: Illya being betrayed a second time becomes Shirou having betrayed her twice.

findings.highlight: I've sworn to do the right thing.
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になると誓った責任
findings.governingReading: 責任 names the responsibility now paid for through the sacrifice, not another bare assertion of the oath.
findings.explanation: Responsibility for the justice-hero oath becomes merely having sworn to do right.
